## U.S. tariff push against Korean semiconductor industry threatens SK Hynix and Samsung

Tariff escalation against Korean foundries and memory producers would raise costs for U.S. hyperscalers and AI infrastructure buyers while pressuring earnings at SK Hynix and Samsung — a systemic supply-chain risk that intersects directly with the ongoing Samsung 2nm/yield and High NA EUV adoption stories.

- U.S. tariff pressure is being directed at Korea's semiconductor sector, per The Korea Times.
- SK Hynix (000660.KS) and Samsung (005930.KS) are identified as the primary affected parties.
- The development adds a geopolitical trade risk layer on top of existing export-control dynamics in the chip supply chain.
- No specific tariff rates, affected product categories, or implementation timelines are detailed in the headline.
